builder_observations.author: Josh Woodward
builder_observations.content: 这条背后有个小故事：Google Labs 的一个小团队想做一款应用，把用户连接到真正重要的内容，同时避开无尽滚动。当时走廊里的提案是“希望式滚动，而不是灾难式滚动”。团队得到“去做吧”的回应。今天，这个小实验开始推出。Dreambeans 是每天为你新鲜冲泡的一剂灵感，我们很期待听到你的反馈。
builder_observations.original_text: A short backstory on this one: A small Google Labs team had an idea to make an app designed to connect you with what matters, without the endless scroll. "Hope scrolling, not doom scrolling" was the hallway pitch. "Go for it." And today, that little experiment is rolling out. Meet Dreambeans, a daily dose of inspiration, brewed fresh for you. We're excited to see what you think!
builder_observations.translation: 这条背后有个小故事：Google Labs 的一个小团队想做一款应用，把用户连接到真正重要的内容，同时避开无尽滚动。当时走廊里的提案是“希望式滚动，而不是灾难式滚动”。团队得到“去做吧”的回应。今天，这个小实验开始推出。Dreambeans 是每天为你新鲜冲泡的一剂灵感，我们很期待听到你的反馈。

builder_observations.author: Google Labs
builder_observations.content: 新实验：Dreambeans 是一款新的实验性移动应用，使用 Personal Intelligence 连接你的 Google 应用。它每天提供个性化故事集合，把你可能错过的内容和与你相关的话题浮现出来，帮助你更深入地了解最关心的事情。今天起，符合条件的美国 Google AI Ultra 用户（18 岁以上）可以使用，官网也开放了 waitlist。了解更多：https://t.co/jCdAzMHvOD
builder_observations.original_text: 🚨 NEW EXPERIMENT 🚨 Dreambeans is a new, experimental mobile app that uses Personal Intelligence to connect to your Google apps. Every day, it delivers collections of personalized stories, surfacing things you might otherwise miss, alongside topics that are relevant to you, to help you dive deeper into the things you care about most. Available starting today for eligible US-based Google AI Ultra users (+18), with an open waitlist found on our website below! Learn more at https://t.co/jCdAzMHvOD
builder_observations.translation: 新实验：Dreambeans 是一款新的实验性移动应用，使用 Personal Intelligence 连接你的 Google 应用。它每天提供个性化故事集合，把你可能错过的内容和与你相关的话题浮现出来，帮助你更深入地了解最关心的事情。今天起，符合条件的美国 Google AI Ultra 用户（18 岁以上）可以使用，官网也开放了 waitlist。了解更多：https://t.co/jCdAzMHvOD
